decision.summaryForCoordinator: This is the cleanest of the four doctor corpora reviewed so far, and one test settles its core claim outright. The two states' verbatimFromV4 strings, concatenated with a single space, are EXACTLY EQUAL by == to live doctor v4's whole FC-NC passProperty. The decomposition is therefore a lossless partition with no residue — nothing dropped, nothing added, and no third limb available to invent. Three further fields are character-for-character equal to live v4 (exactByteIntent, and alsoCovers in both places it is quoted) and all four remaining quotations are true substrings. Unlike the FC-RO sibling, no quoted field here is truncated. The two prohibitions with real teeth were tested mechanically rather than read. First, the sentinel: v4 requires it written 'to a known path', and the full path sweep returns only the eight cited artifact paths, file 08, the implementation negation, and four slash-containing tokens from quoted v4 prose — no candidate sentinel path of any shape exists, and the nine 64-hex strings in the subject are exactly the nine cited digests, so no trace, sentinel, report or consent-record bytes are pinned either. Second, the G12/G21 split, which is where this class could most easily go wrong: the subject's claim is corroborated by three independent live sources that agree and none of which places the property at G12 — G12 v2's own EV-4 passProperty says in terms 'The FC-NC consented CA-1 process-tree containment property is G21, not this gate', v4's ID-DEP-11 rides containment on 'DR-G21 (PROPOSED) for the containment behavior of a CA-1 probe's process tree', and file 08's live DR-G21 harness column lists 'process-tree' in its corpus. NA-4 was attacked at the source rather than in the subject: every NA-4 occurrence in live v4 was extracted, and it exists in exactly one substantive place, FC-NC's alsoCovers, with no class of its own — so 'not a third fixture' is right, and the subject attaches the check to both states as v4's class-level placement requires. The four Snapshot/Plan/Run/Execution tokens appear only inside quotations of v4's negative test and inside the doesNot negation; nothing is minted. Custody is clean: subject unmoved at de6c0b12 and 0444 at both samplings, nine of nine cited digests equal live bytes including the new G21 v3 pin, every cited standing opened and confirmed at Claude ACCEPT 0/0 with no Codex verdict existing anywhere in this family, the D-164 join confirms OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING still leftoverDesign true with owner none and FC-NC inside its twelve, the thirteen-join-fixture count is right, file 08 pin equal to live with zero modified tracked files repo-wide, HEAD 5d5d778, required-now 26, thirty gate rows, and SATISFIED and QUALIFIED occur zero times. Twenty-two attacks run, twenty-two refuted, zero findings. Three things for you. Two standing annotations have gone stale by chronology rather than by error — 'the last Claude ACCEPT 0/0 G12 subject' was true at 05:48:45 and the G12 v4 ACCEPT landed at 05:51:08, and 'Awaiting independent review' for the FC-RO sibling was true at authoring and its ACCEPT landed at 06:06:07. I wrote both of those verdicts and disclose it. This is now the fifth corpus to pin G12 v2 and the fourth review to raise the referent, so settling it once would close it for the series. Third and smallest: this corpus routes containment to DR-G21 without noting that G21 is itself PROPOSED and OPEN, where the FC-RO sibling wrote 'Rides DR-124 OPEN' for its equivalent ride; matching that phrasing would put the ride's readiness in one place.
